utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the exact repair drive details again? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — we’re still on for this weekend. What time should I plan to drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — what time on Saturday should I plan to drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got the drill and screwdrivers ready for the repair drive. If you hear of anything else we need, just let me know and I’ll try to pick it up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Sam — that’s a big help. I’ll swing by a bit late, but I’m ready to grab whatever’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem — I’ll keep an eye on what’s left and set it aside for you. See you when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still planning to swing by the repair drive later and see what they need. If you’re going, I can tag along and help out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, so it’s really happening then? Just checking before I mention the repair drive to anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, it’s definitely happening — I’m still planning to swing by later and see what they need. Feel free to mention it, and I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still planning to check in later and see what they need for the repair drive. If you want, we can head over together after that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I can go after school if it’s still Sunday at the community center. Just let me know what time you check in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll check in and confirm the time, then I’ll let you know so we can head over after school.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—just send me the drop-off locations for the repair drive, and I’ll keep them neatly listed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. I’ll keep the drop-off spots listed neatly for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks for the update — I’ve got Sunday at the community center noted, and I’ll keep the drop-off list neat.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll check the repair drive details and send you the date, time, and drop-off info.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — thanks, Noah! I’m ready to share it with anyone who asks, and I’ll keep the missing-supplies list handy too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll make sure I grab the latest details and pass them along if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Leo. It’s for the neighborhood shed this Saturday, and I’m still mainly looking for spare screwdrivers and a small pry bar.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for spare screwdrivers and a small pry bar. Send me the shed details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Leo. I’ll send the shed details, and we can keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s still doing great—folks have been bringing in tools and supplies all morning. Drill bits and extra screwdrivers are still the biggest needs, so I’ll keep an eye out for those.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — I’m glad it’s moving along. I still need the exact drop-off time and the final fix list before I can plan my end.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out for the exact drop-off time and the final fix list, and I’ll pass them along as soon as I hear. The drive’s still filling up nicely, so I’m hopeful we’ll know soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — just send the rest when you can, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll send the rest over soon. Thanks for taking it from there, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for it and jump in once you send the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Rey — could you come by around 2 this afternoon? We’ll start sorting donations first, then check the tools after.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can come by around 2. What should I bring for the sorting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any new updates yet, but I can check while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. If you hear anything, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything about the drop-off time or repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking, Gus — the repair drive’s now on Sunday at the community center. If you can help spread the word, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll spread the word and let folks know it’s Sunday at the community center. Happy to help out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Gus — thank you. If you hear anyone who can lend a hand or bring tools, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s now on Sunday at the community center. I’m checking what we still need so I can share a clear list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll send over the list as soon as I finish checking, and if you can help sort any supplies, that would be lovely.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the remaining basics, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll send over the remaining basics as soon as I can. Thanks, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Dane — just the quick list is fine, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what’s the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: It’s just a neighborhood repair drive to help fix up a few things around the block. We’re gathering tools and supplies, and I might need a reminder on the exact date too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good—I can help gather tools and supplies. What’s the exact date again?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — that’ll be a big help. See you at the repair drive, and we’ll take it one fix at a time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — I’ll bring those by. Thanks, Gus, and I’ll keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks—once you have the exact time and fix list, send them over and I’ll plan my drop-off around that.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Pia — I’ll send the Saturday time and fix list as soon as I have it. I’m still mainly after spare screwdrivers and a small pry bar.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks, Eli — I’ll wait for the Saturday time and fix list before I set anything in stone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send me the details and I’ll help sort the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, send the missing-supplies list too and I’ll check what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. Just send me the details when you can, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Nell — I’ll send the repair drive details right away and keep you down for check-in and supply sorting.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — I’ll watch for your message and plan on check-in and supply sorting.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s for the repair drive on Sunday at the community center—I’m checking what supplies we already have and what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard anything new yet, but I’ll ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the repair drive this weekend, and what time should I plan for drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, we’re still on for the repair drive this weekend — I’m checking in later to see what they still need. If you want, we can head over together after that and I’ll let you know the drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — just let me know the drop-off time once you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — come by around 3 this afternoon, and I’ll have the donation sorting ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — 3 this afternoon works. I’ll come by and help with the donation sorting.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Hana — I’ll see you at 3, and I’ll have everything set up for the sorting.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must’ve missed the update; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Drill bits and extra screwdrivers are still the biggest needs, if you’ve got any to spare. I’ll keep an eye out too, and anything else useful is welcome.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — I can check whether I’ve got any drill bits or screwdrivers to spare and bring them by. Thanks for keeping an eye out too.
